```{r setup, results='hide', message=FALSE}
## load packages:
library(data.table)
library(writexl)
library(arsenal)
library(CRP)
library(gt)

source("20_functions/source_dir.R")
source_dir("20_functions")
```

## Read data

```{r}
dbl0 <- readRDS(file = "02_data_derived/baselinedata.rds")
dbacs <- readRDS(file = "02_data_derived/bacs_derived.rds")
dbl <- merge(dbl0, dbacs, by = c("ID", "trt"), all.x = TRUE)
```


## Baseline table

```{r, results='asis'}
ctr <- tableby.control(numeric.stats = c("Nmiss", "meansd", "medianrange"),
                       cat.stats = c("Nmiss", "countpct"),
                       stats.labels=list(Nmiss = "Missing", Nmiss2 = "Missing",
                                         meansd = "Mean (SD)", range = "Range",
                                         medianrange = "Median (Range)",
                                         gmeansd = "Geom Mean (Geom SD)"),
                       chisq.correct = FALSE, digits = 1, test.always = FALSE)

tab <- tableby(trt ~ c_sex + n_age + f_age40 + f_race + 
                 madrs_total10 + f_madrs10_30 + f_dep_recurrent + 
                 n_dep_lifetime_episodes + f_dep_current_duration + 
                 f_treatment_resistant + 
                 f_psyk_aktuelt + f_antal_antidep_all + 
                 f_cur_psychotherapy + f_prev_psychotherapy + 
                 f_ambulant_indlagt + 
                 f_somatic_comorbid + 
                 n_bmi + f_bmi30 + 
                 f_crp2 + 
                 f_smoking + f_employment + 
                 n_bacs, 
               data=droplevels(dbl), control=ctr, test=FALSE)

tab <- set_labels(tab, c(
  c_sex                   = "Sex assigned at birth",
  n_age                   = "Age (years)",
  f_age40                 = "Age (distribution)",
  f_race                  = "Race or ethnic group",
  madrs_total10           = "MADRS~10~ at pre-treatment baseline",
  f_madrs10_30            = "MADRS~10~ (distribution)",
  f_dep_recurrent         = "Recurrent depressive episode",
  n_dep_lifetime_episodes = "No. lifetime dep. episodes",
  f_dep_current_duration  = "Duration of cur. dep. episode",
  f_treatment_resistant   = "Treatment-resistant depression (TRD)",
  f_somatic_comorbid      = "Comorbid somatic disorders",
  n_bmi                   = "Body-mass index",
  f_bmi30                 = "Body-mass index (distribution)",
  f_crp2                  = "C-reactive protein (mg/L)",
  f_smoking               = "Smoking status",
  f_employment            = "Employment status",
  n_bacs                  = "BACS score",
  #
  # f_antal_antidep_all     = "Different current or previous**\n**pharmacological treatments for depression",
  f_antal_antidep_all     = "No. pharma. treatments for depression",
  f_psyk_aktuelt          = "Comorbid psychiatric disorders",
  f_cur_psychotherapy     = "Current use of psychotherapy",
  f_prev_psychotherapy    = "Previous use of psychotherapy",
  f_ambulant_indlagt      = "Current treatment setting"))

# write2word(tab, file=paste0(getwd(), "/results/", Sys.Date(), 
#                             "_baseline_characteristics_table1.docx"),
#            quiet = TRUE)

if(interactive()) 
  summary(tab, text = TRUE, term.name = TRUE, test=FALSE) 
if(!interactive()) 
  summary(tab, term.name = TRUE, test=FALSE)
```


```{r}
## Save baseline table to file:
y <- as.data.frame(summary(tab, text=TRUE, term.name=TRUE, test=FALSE)) |>
  as.data.table()
nm <- names(y)[1]
y[, (nm) := trimws(gsub("^\\-", "", get(nm)))]

## Save baseline table:
write_xlsx(y, path = paste0("02_data_derived/", 
                            "baseline_characteristics_table1.xlsx"))
```

Make gt-table:
```{r}
y2 <- copy(y)
# y2[, trt := gsub("**\n**", " ", trt, fixed = TRUE)]
colnms <- names(y2)
y2[nchar(get(colnms[2])) == 0, trt := paste0("**", trt, "**")]
y2[, trt := gsub("<=", "\u2264", trt)]
y2[, trt := gsub(">=", "\u2265", trt)]
setnames(y2, "trt", "Treatment")

gt_tab <- gt(y2) |> 
  set_gt_style() 

footer_list <- 
  list(scale = "Randomly assigned participants received one-week oral dexamethasone or placebo as add-on therapy to standard therapy with anti-depressants. Percentages may not total 100 because of rounding.",
       "Data are 'n (%)' unless otherwise specified.",
       abbrev = paste(
         "Race or ethnic group: Race or ethnic group as self-reported by the participants.",
         "MADRS~10~: 10-item total score on the Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) range from 0 to 60, with higher scores indicating greater severity of depression. At baseline, all patients had a score of at least 22 on the MADRS.",
         "Depression severity: Moderate depression is defined as MADRS~10~ \u2264 29 and severe depression is defined as MADRS~10~ \u2265 30.",
         "Treatment-resistant depression (TRD): Defined as two or more trials of different antidepressants within the current depressive episode.",
         "Body-mass index: The weight in kilograms divided by the square of the height in meters.",
         "BACS: Score on the Brief Assessment of Cognition test standardized to the trial population, with lower scores indicating lower cognitive functioning.",
         "SD: Standard deviation", "C-reactive protein: high sensitivity C-reactive protein (unit: mg/L)"))

for(footer in footer_list) {
    gt_tab <- gt_tab |>
      tab_source_note(source_note = md(as.character(footer)))
  }

tlf_reg <- get_metadata()
regi <- tlf_reg[file_stem == "baseline_table"]

save_gt_table(gt_tab, 
              regi = regi, 
              verbose = TRUE)
gt_tab
```


## Baseline table for subgroups

```{r, results='asis'}
tab <- tableby(trt ~ sex + f_age40 + f_bmi30 + f_madrs10_30 + 
                 f_treatment_resistant, data=droplevels(dbl), control=ctr,
               test=FALSE)

tab <- set_labels(tab, c(
  sex = "Sex",
  f_age40 = "Age",
  f_bmi30 = "Body-mass index",
  f_madrs10_30 = "Depression severity",
  f_treatment_resistant = "Treatment-resistant"
))

# write2word(tab, file=paste0(getwd(), "/results/", Sys.Date(), 
#                             "_baseline_characteristics_subgroups.docx"),
#            quiet = TRUE)

if(interactive()) 
  summary(tab, text = TRUE, term.name = TRUE, test=FALSE) 
if(!interactive()) 
  summary(tab, term.name = TRUE, test=FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Save baseline table to file:
y <- as.data.frame(summary(tab, text=TRUE, term.name=TRUE, test=FALSE)) |>
  as.data.table()
nm <- names(y)[1]
y[, (nm) := trimws(gsub("^\\-", "", get(nm)))]

## Save baseline table:
write_xlsx(y, path = paste0("02_data_derived/", 
                            "baseline_characteristics_subgroups.xlsx"))
```
